text:
Alex R: Heads up — seeing a surge of 503s and streaming timeouts on hosted-api since ~22:10 UTC. Customer escalations coming in. Opening triage thread. Route: /v1/generate. Affected regions: us-central, eu-west.

OpsBot: Alert: 5xx rate increased from 0.6% -> 7.8% in 5m; error codes 503/504. Spike coincides with 22:08 deploy (deploy-frontend-2026-03-12-2208).

DeployBot: Deployment 2026-03-12T22:08:07Z to routing plane completed. Rollback gate open.

Sam K: Can we get top-stack traces + ingress logs? I'll tail apigw and proxy logs.

Maria C: I'm seeing large embedding batch traffic from customer ACME corp — huge batch sizes causing queueing at the runtime. p90 token counts jumped 4x.

Jun L: KV-cache miss rate also jumped ~3x at 22:10 — suggests cold cache. Batcher queue depth hit 90% on some pods.

Olivia P: Auth proxy latencies spiked too — maybe upstream token validation timeout cascading. 401s minimal, mostly 504s from auth service.

Alex R: Immediate mitigations: (1) enable fallback routing to smaller model variant for hosted-api prod (model-x-small) (2) temporarily increase pool concurrency + spin extra workers in us-central (3) roll back 22:08 deploy if we see config mismatch. @Sam K take (2), @Maria C take (1).

Sam K: Kicking autoscale for runtime pool now: `kubectl scale deployment runtime-pool-us-central --replicas=10` — bumped from 4 -> 10. Watching queue depth.

Maria C: Fallback routing rule applied to /v1/generate for high token requests — will divert to model-x-small for >4096 tokens. Patching rollout config now.

Jun L: Warmup job started for KV cache on affected hosts: `curl -s https://warmup.internal/... | jq .status` — injecting prefixes for heavy tenants.

Olivia P: Throttling rule on auth proxy relaxed for 10m to avoid auth timeouts. Monitoring for abuse.

Sam K: After scale, 503s dropped to 1.2% over last 2m. Latency p95 improved ~400ms. Still seeing some tail 504s from eu-west.

Alex R: Good. Action items: 1) postmortem owners: Alex R (lead), Maria C (model routing), Sam K (autoscale playbook), Jun L (kv cache warmup), Olivia P (auth proxy). 2) Follow-up retrospective in 48h with runbook updates. 3) Customer comms: @support prepare status email for impacted tenants. I'll keep thread open until stable for 30m.

SupportBot: Noted — support notified, drafting template.

Alex R: Closing triage for now — monitoring until 23:00 UTC. Thank you all :thumbsup:
